newsitem.title: USA: Infinite Graphics sees FY97 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Infinite Graphics sees FY97 profit up.

text.p: Infinite Graphics Inc said on Thursday it that it expects higher sales and profits in fiscal year 1997.
The company earlier reported net income of $143,565, or $0.05 a share for the fiscal year ended April 30, compared with a loss of $380,430, or $0.17 a share a year ago.

"The company is focused on strengthening our existing business, while positioning ourselves to add new locations in fiscal 1997," said Clifford Stritch, chief executive officer. "We expect even greater sales and profits in fiscal 1997."
